scope: Independent nanoda typecheck of the selected-schedule tail coefficient and pressure bounds, plus the existential rate-capped prepared/full ProfileData construction and the derived tail clock-weight mass upper bound P^2/50.
limitations: The rate-capped result is existential and does not transfer to FinalSlowBase.actualProfile.

The result supplies one conditional pressure-tail bound, not a full pressure-sign conclusion or physical/molecular consequence.

The tail mass estimate is a one-sided upper bound for the existential rate-capped profile under the recorded source cap; it is not a concentration lower bound or a property of FinalSlowBase.actualProfile.
